News 🗞️
 "SC has decided to accept PEP 824 [None-coalescing operators] on the condition that the ??= operator is removed, leaving only the ?? operator in the proposal.
 "We see value in ?? as an explicit way to express a fallback for None...
 "However, it does not mean that an assignment form is also justified. Syntax additions need to offer a clear benefit to readers, and SC members remain unconv

top_posts.author: hugovk
top_posts.text:
?? is the none-coalescing operator.
??= is the none-coalescing assignment operator.
 What is ?? ?
 From the PEP:
 `a ?? b` is equivalent to `a if a is not None else b`, except that `a` is only evaluated once.
 Similarly, `a or b` is equivalent to `a if a else b`, with `a` evaluated only once.
   https://  peps.python.org/pep-0824/#how-  to-teach-this
